subject: 藏地平顶石砌仓屋（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create exactly ONE isolated city-map sprite for tianshu, historical Tibetan regional kit. Realistic ancient material detail and crisp restrained weathering matching the attached Song reference; reinterpret the subject in Tibetan stone/wood/cloth construction, not Chinese gray-tiled gables. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection, yaw45 pitch30, NO perspective convergence. BOTH ground axes MUST form exactly slopes +0.5 and -0.5 in screen space, opposite edges parallel, upright vertical posts. The ground-plane bounding diamond must be twice as wide as high. Thin natural ground contact, clearly visible LEFT, FRONT and RIGHT ground corners; no thick display slab. South/front faces screen lower left. Opaque solid object with real RGBA background transparency; no luminous rim, haze, glow, baked white or checkerboard. Warm-neutral light from screen UPPER LEFT, tiny short soft contact shadow lower right. Entire asset centered with at least10% transparent margins, no cropping. No people, animals, writing, marks resembling lettering, shop signs, watermark, labels, grid, modern elements, background scenery, road, sky, floating island, diorama base, cartoon or toy. Original generic regional adaptation; not a named historical monument. Asset ID bld_kit_tubo_warehouse. One Tibetan town storeroom/warehouse,9m east-west by7m north-south rectangular footprint, ground axis ratio exactly9:7. A low single-storey substantial stone storehouse with flat earth roof, modest stone parapet, thick slightly battered plastered walls revealing brown-gray rubble stone at lower half, two high small dark rectangular ventilation windows, broad closed double wooden loading doors on south facade facing lower-left. A few unmarked tightly bound sacks and one plain barrel under shallow dark wood lintel beside door, entirely within footprint; keep threshold clear. Muted off-white and warm gray stone, subdued brown wood, a very narrow ochre-red line beneath roof; no golden roof, ornate palace decor, no Chinese sloping tiled roof. Ground outline nearly square, visible ground edges slopes+0.5 and-0.5. Reference material and realistic detail only; do not make tea house or multi-storey commercial building. No exterior courtyard or additional buildings. Opaque walls and roof, true transparency all around.

alternatives.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. First reference is the EDIT TARGET warehouse: keep the same one-storey Tibetan whitewashed stone storeroom with flat earthen roof, parapet, dark wood double doors, small high dark windows, tiny sacks and barrel at door side. Second reference is ONLY a camera-guide guardhouse; do not add its second floor. Correct only the target camera from the current too-shallow ground slopes about0.45 to true2:1 dimetric slopes+0.5/-0.5, yaw45 pitch30, parallel opposite edges and upright walls. Rectangle9m east-west by7m north-south, ground edge length ratio9:7. Ground vertices may approximately be LEFT(0.14,0.58), FRONT(0.545,0.7825), RIGHT(0.86,0.625), BACK(0.455,0.4225); no labels or grid. Render a complete isolated map sprite with full building and thin natural contact footprint, no raised display base. Realistic neutral earth stone colors, no shiny toy material. Upper-left key light, short lower-right contact shadow. Genuine transparent RGBA, opaque solid architecture and no glow or halo. Generous transparent padding; no cropping, no white backdrop, text, humans, animals, scenery or modern objects.
alternatives.rejection: 第二候选视角仍约±0.46，宽深比约1.50更偏离9:7；选首候选，保留未通过几何标记

negative: 人物、动物、文字、现代物、天空、景观、厚展示地台、假透明、透视汇聚、光晕
